content: A sandbox in WikiDoc refers to a designated space where users can practice basic editing commands. It serves as a practical medium for learning and refining editing skills. It is strongly advised to use the sandbox in conjunction with training on basic editing techniques to maximize learning outcomes. For example, John Smith's user sandbox could be named sandbox:JS, sandbox:JSmith, sandbox:JohnSmith, or sandbox:JSM. To create a sandbox, press the Go button. This action will generate a new page that can be utilized as a practice field both during and after training sessions. If you wish to watch an instructional video on how to use the sandbox, you can click the provided link. To return to the WikiDoc Scholar Program homepage, click the corresponding link.
